identity.description: A Docker container with a web-based management interface for retrieving SSL certificates from Porkbun and hosting them in a mounted volume.

headings.text: Upgrading from a version without authentication
Two gotchas this script exists to handle
DSM API notes (learned the hard way against DSM 7.3.2)

symbols.name: PASSWORD_HASH_METHOD
symbols.signature: PASSWORD_HASH_METHOD = 'scrypt:32768:8:1'   # pinned so a werkzeug bump can't change it silently

symbols.name: PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH
symbols.signature: PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH = 1024                  # cheap DoS guard on the KDF input

symbols.name: IP_FREE_ATTEMPTS
symbols.signature: IP_FREE_ATTEMPTS = 10                       # looser: a proxy can collapse every client into one bucket

symbols.name: ATTEMPT_WINDOW
symbols.signature: ATTEMPT_WINDOW = 1800                       # a bucket idle this long is forgotten
